static_network.scope: Asymptotic static scattering only; no finite-deadline stored-cavity equivalence or moving-field coupling claim.
static_network.finite_time_warning: Do not reinterpret classical LC energy as bare-photon probability; quantum memory is dressed at strong coupling.

asymptotic_reference_certificate.scope: Static stationary scattering of the full prepared positive-frequency packet, not switch-on-at-zero or finite-deadline possession. Each carrier is one photon in two identical independent rails. All environments vacuum; greybody and eta dilations identical in both comparisons.

embedding_nonidentifiability_witness.model: Two resonant positive-frequency modes with H=Omega(Na+Nb)+g(r)(a†b+b†a); profile1 g0, profile2 g0*r/r0 on [4,20]. Positive single-particle Hamiltonian, vacuum invariant. Distinct possible spatial embeddings, not same fully specified hardware.
embedding_nonidentifiability_witness.interpretation: All static dynamics coincide because g1(20)=g2(20). Static calibration cannot select their off-worldline coupling profiles. This is an identifiability witness, not a Schwarzschild detector prediction.
